identitySignals: Federal SAM.gov entity record (via OpenGovUS mirror) lists 'CANVA US, INC.' at 3212 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX, matching the agenda's 'Canva USA, Inc.' in Austin, TX
Canva's own privacy policy describes Canva Education for schools, matching OUSD's Technology Services contract with a Standard Student Data Privacy Agreement
Canva publicly offers California-specific student data privacy agreements to school districts, consistent with the agenda's Subscription Agreement and Student Data Privacy Agreement
research.notes: Agenda spells the name 'Canva USA, Inc.'; the federal SAM record spells it 'CANVA US, INC.' (Delaware corporation, Austin TX address). Other school districts' agreements are with the parent Canva Pty Ltd (Sydney, Australia), so the parent's headquarters is not used here. Canva's own pages block automated fetching (403), so no phone or email could be sourced; CA Secretary of State entity number and EIN not verified. The address comes from the SAM mirror, not an official Canva page.

profile.address: 3212 E Cesar Chavez St Bldg 1 Ste 1300, Austin, TX 78702-4938
profile.summary: Canva is an online design platform used to create presentations, documents, social media graphics and other visual content. It offers business plans and a version for schools called Canva Education. Canva US, Inc. is the company's U.S. entity, registered in Delaware.

sources.title: Canva Us, Inc. - SAM entity record (OpenGovUS)

review.notes: The SAM.gov record (OpenGovUS mirror) shows CANVA US, INC., a Delaware for-profit corporation in Austin, TX. That matches the agenda's Canva USA, Inc. in Austin, and a subscription plus student data privacy agreement fits Canva Education. The privacy policy supports the design-platform, business-plan and Canva Education wording in the neutral summary, and the Delaware, address, UEI and legal name come from the SAM record.
